Use this page if your study needs healthcare costs per person. The registers
hold no single cost variable: costs are assembled from several sources, each
priced in its own way. This page says where the costs are, and how to read the
DRG (Diagnosis Related Groups) registers at Statistics Denmark (DST), which
put a price on hospital contacts. How to analyse the costs once you have them is on [Analysing
costs](analysing-costs.qmd).

::: {.callout-warning}
**Check your own delivery.** The registers and years below were checked against
[DST's register
overview](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Oversigt%20over%20registre.html)
in November 2026. The Danish Health Data Authority (Sundhedsdatastyrelsen, SDS)
changes the tariffs and the grouping logic every year, so column names and
years can change. Compare with `colnames()` in your own data.
:::

## Where costs come from {#sources}

- **Somatic hospital contacts** (all hospital contacts outside psychiatry):
  priced by DRG. SDS places each hospital contact in a DRG group and sets a
  tariff (a fixed price) for each group every year: the average operating cost
  of a patient in that group ([SDS DRG
  rates](https://sundhedsdatastyrelsen.dk/data-og-registre/sundhedsoekonomi/drg/drg-takster)).
  In the LPR2 period (the National Patient Register before 2019, see
  [Understand LPR](understand-lpr.qmd)), inpatients were grouped by DRG and
  outpatients by DAGS (Dansk Ambulant Grupperings System, the Danish
  outpatient grouping system) ([SDS, DRG-grouped
  LPR](https://www.esundhed.dk/Dokumentation/DocumentationExtended?id=12)).
  Today all somatic patients are settled (priced for payment) with DRG tariffs ([Takstvejledning
  2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf),
  section 3.1). Which registers DST holds is in [DRG data at
  DST](#drg-at-dst).
- **Psychiatric hospital contacts:** are not settled by DRG. Inpatients are
  settled with a bed-day rate and outpatient visits with a visit rate. SDS
  calculated indicative DRG and DAGS tariffs for psychiatry up to tariff system
  2018 ([Takstvejledning
  2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf),
  section 3.2), and DST holds them in `DRGPSYK_HEL` and `DRGPSYK_AMB`. Whether
  the current DRG registers hold psychiatric activity is unclear, see
  [Psychiatry in the LPR3 (the patient register from 2019) DRG registers](#psychiatry). Keep somatic and
  psychiatric costs apart.
- **Primary sector** (general practice, specialists etc.): fees in
  `sysi`/`sssy` ([Overview of
  registers](register-reference.qmd#sysi-sssy)).
- **Prescription medication:** patient co-payment and reimbursement in the
  prescription register, [LMDB](register-reference.qmd#lmdb)
  (Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret).
- **Medication given in hospital:** [Hospital medication](hospital-medication.qmd)
  (the Hospital Medication Register, SMR), but read [What a DRG price
  covers](#drg-price-covers) before you add it to DRG prices.

## DRG data at DST {#drg-at-dst}

DST holds the DRG-grouped data in a separate set of registers for each period,
so a study period that crosses 2018 needs more than one set ([DST's register
overview](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Oversigt%20over%20registre.html)):

  | Register                                                    | Content                                        | Years                  | Status                 |
  | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------- |
  | `DRGSOMA_HEL`, `DRGSOMA_AMB`                                | LPR2, inpatients and outpatients               | 2002-2017              | Closed 15 January 2024 |
  | `DRGSOMA_KONTAKT`, `DRGSOMA_SGHFORLOB`, `DRGSOMA_PROCEDURE` | Contacts, hospital courses and procedures      | 2018                   | Closed 15 January 2024 |
  | `DRGPSYK_HEL`, `DRGPSYK_AMB`                                | Indicative psychiatric tariffs                 | 2004-2018              | Closed 15 January 2024 |
  | `DRG_KONTAKTER`, `DRG_SGHFORLOB`                            | LPR3, contacts and hospital courses            | Tariff years 2021-2025 | Updated yearly         |
  | `DRG_DIAGNOSE`, `DRG_PROCEDURE` and three more              | LPR3, diagnoses, procedures and internal codes | Tariff years 2022-2025 | Updated yearly         |

The columns of `DRG_KONTAKTER` and `DRG_SGHFORLOB` are listed on [Overview of
registers](register-reference.qmd#drg-lpr3).

<details>
<summary>The LPR2 registers, and stays that crossed into LPR3 in 2019</summary>

- In `DRGSOMA_HEL` and `DRGSOMA_AMB`, `V_PRIS` is given in 1,000 kr. ("Angivet
  i 1.000 kr."), and for inpatients `V_AAR` is the year of discharge from the
  last contact of the course, so costs follow the discharge year ([SDS,
  DRG-grouped
  LPR](https://www.esundhed.dk/Dokumentation/DocumentationExtended?id=12)).
- A stay that crossed the change to LPR3 in 2019 is priced on its LPR3 course.
  Its LPR2 course gets the group 90UA07 "Flyttet til DRG LPR3" (moved to DRG
  LPR3) ([SDS, DRG-grouped LPR3 data, tariff system
  2019](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15120/DRG_grupperet_LPR3_data_2019.pdf),
  section 3.4.3.3).

</details>

## The year of an LPR3 DRG file is the tariff year {#drg-tariff-year}

SDS publishes a new set of tariffs every year, the tariff system for that year
(Takstsystem 2025, for example). LPR3 is the National Patient Register from
2019. In `DRG_KONTAKTER` and `DRG_SGHFORLOB` the year in the file name is the tariff
year ("Takståret"), not the year the activity took place. Each yearly file
holds that year and the two years before it, given by `AKTIVITETSAAR` ([DST,
register note for
DRG_KONTAKTER](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Bemaerkning/DRG_KONTAKTER%20-%20Landspatientregistret%20(LPR3)%20takster%20%E2%80%93%20DRG%20kontakter.html)).
The first release grouped tariff system 2021 with activity years 2019 to 2021
and tariff system 2022 with 2020 to 2022 ([DST, register history for
DRG_KONTAKTER](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Registerhistorik/DRG_KONTAKTER.html),
14 May 2024). `AKTIVITETSAAR` is the year the last contact of the hospital
course ended ([SDS, DRG-grouped LPR3 data, tariff system
2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
section 3).

- **Do not stack the yearly files.** Most activity is in three files, priced
  each time with a different tariff system.
- **Prices compare within one tariff system.** Tariffs hold for one calendar
  year, and SDS groups several activity years in each file so that the years
  "kan sammenlignes i samme takstsystem" (can be compared in the same tariff
  system) ([SDS, tariff system
  2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
  section 6.3).
- **Prices are in the tariff year's price level.** A tariff system gives its
  tariffs in that year's price and wage level, for example "2024 pris- og
  lønniveau" in [Takstvejledning
  2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf)
  (section 3.1). Bring all years to one price year before you sum or compare
  across years ([how](analysing-costs.qmd#price-year)).

There are two consistent ways to choose rows. The first is one tariff system:
take one file and its three activity years. The prices compare across those
years, but you get three years at most. The second is each year's own tariffs:
take each activity year from the file with the same tariff year
(`AKTIVITETSAAR` equal to the year in the file name). There are no files for
tariff years 2019 and 2020, so take those two activity years from the 2021
file. The second way follows from how DST builds the files; it is not a DST
recommendation.

## Price per contact or per hospital course: use one, not both {#drg-price-level}

LPR3 records a hospital stay as one or more **contacts**: a patient moved from
one department to another has a contact in each. SDS joins the contacts of one
person at the same hospital, in the same course of illness and each starting at
most four hours after the previous one ended, into one **hospital course**
(DRG-sygehusforløb) ([SDS,
tariff system 2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
section 3). Both are priced:

- `DRG_KONTAKTER` has one row per contact. `PRIS_DRG` is the tariff of the
  contact's DRG group.
- `DRG_SGHFORLOB` has one row per hospital course. `PRIS_DRG_DRGSGHF` is the
  tariff of the course's DRG group.

`TOTALPRIS_DRG` and `TOTALPRIS_DRGSGHF` add the long-stay price, an extra
payment for each day beyond the group's usual length of stay (its trim point)
([SDS, tariff system 2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
Tabel 25). The two registers price the same hospital activity, so adding the
contact prices and the course prices counts it twice. Choose one of them.

Use the hospital course unless you have a reason not to. Somatic hospital
treatment is settled "pr. DRG-sygehusforløb" (per DRG hospital course)
([Takstsystem
2026](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/639014923392486672/Takstsystem%202026.pdf),
section 3.1.1), so `TOTALPRIS_DRGSGHF` is the price that was settled. A contact
price comes from grouping that contact on its own. It helps when you need to
place costs at a date within a long course, but the sum of the contact prices
need not equal the course price.

## What a DRG price covers {#drg-price-covers}

A tariff reflects the calculated direct costs of treating the patient and of
rehabilitation. It does not include, for example, civil-servant pensions,
interest or depreciation ([Takstvejledning
2024](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/media/15344/Takstvejledning_2024.pdf),
section 3.1).

Medication can go wrong in both directions:

- **Ordinary hospital medicine is in the DRG price.** Medicine treatment is
  itself grouped and priced in DRG, for example in the groups 34PR01 to 34PR10
  "Medicin-behandling" ([Takstsystem
  2026](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/639014923392486672/Takstsystem%202026.pdf),
  Bilag B3.2). Adding costs from the [Hospital Medication
  Register](hospital-medication.qmd) on top of DRG prices can count it twice.
- **Expensive medicine is not.** Medicine dispensed for more than 1,000 kr. per
  day is a special service (særydelse, SYD02), settled separately at cost
  ([Takstsystem
  2026](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/639014923392486672/Takstsystem%202026.pdf),
  Bilagstabel 7), so the DRG price leaves it out. DST's variable lists for
  `DRG_KONTAKTER` and `DRG_SGHFORLOB` have no column for special services.

## Psychiatry in the LPR3 DRG registers {#psychiatry}

SDS writes that the DRG-grouped LPR3 data hold "Kun somatisk aktivitet"
(somatic activity only) ([SDS, tariff system
2025](https://cdn1.gopublic.dk/sundhedsdatastyrelsen/Media/638769532677303948/DRG-grupperet%20LPR3-data%20-%20Takstsystem%202025%20-%20Dokumentation.pdf),
section 3.4.1.2). DST's register history for `DRGPSYK_HEL` says the register
was closed because the psychiatric tariffs are now included with the somatic
ones "i det nye DRG" (in the new DRG), in `DRG_KONTAKTER` and `DRG_SGHFORLOB`
([DST, register history for
DRGPSYK_HEL](https://www.dst.dk/extranet/ForskningVariabellister/Registerhistorik/DRGPSYK_HEL.html),
15 January 2024). The two statements do not agree. Tabulate `SPECIALE` (the department's
specialty) in your own delivery before you assume that psychiatric contacts are present or absent.
